rationale: The Dutch Council of State (RvS) decision concerns an administrative enforcement order (last onder dwangsom) requiring a facility (Orion) in Drachten to cease discharging polychlorinated biphenyl (PCB)-containing wastewater (afvalwater). Because the dispute directly adjudicates industrial effluent/wastewater pollution control and wastewater discharge enforcement, both water labels are WATER and the primary governance category is environmental_protection.
